messages:
Maya (CSM): quick heads-up — Kestrel's onboarding perf is dipping at 95th pct on chat flows. renewal flag in 8 weeks so i'd like to propose a low-risk perf play.
Devon (SE): yea saw that in the dashboard. traffic spiky during batch imports, long tail token times. do we have perf profiles by prompt length?
Samira (Infra): attaching a short sample from logs: ``errors: none, avg_token_ms: 12, p95_token_ms: 88, seq_len_med: 96``. Most requests are <200 tokens but a small subset is ~1k.
Maya (CSM): thanks. customer is sensitive to cost too — wants latency better but can't accept hallucination regressions.
Devon (SE): suggest a two-prong canary: 1) quantized variant (int8) for short/medium seqs; 2) split-path routing for long-sequence requests to a memory-optimized model. start at 5% traffic for quant, 100% of long seqs to model-B.
Samira (Infra): agree. we'll use prefix-based routing + seq-length header. Proposed routing rule snip:
``
route:
  - match: request.seq_len <= 256
    model: model-x-quant-int8-canary
    weight: 0.05
  - match: request.seq_len > 256
    model: model-x-large-kv
```
Devon (SE): will add rate limit exceptions + sticky sessions for session chat to avoid mixing caches.
Maya (CSM): how do we monitor quality drift for quant canary? customer wants "no unexpected output changes".
Samira (Infra): we'll wire a lightweight eval: run 200 sample prompts through both variants and compare BLEU/ROUGE + a short embedding cosine check. if delta > 0.02 embedding sim or any safety classifier change -> rollback.
ops-bot: deploy job started: canary-int8 -> 2023-11-02T14:04Z (job id: canary-4387). :gear:
Ryan (AE): good — i'll frame this as a "staged latency improvement" in the renewal plan. can we capture expected $/token delta? the finance team will ask.
Devon (SE): estimated unit cost down ~22% on quant path for eligible requests. i'll share a quick calc in the thread.
Devon (SE): calc: baseline 0.012 USD/token * 1.0 = 0.012; int8 path 0.0093 USD/token -> ~22.5% saving for routed tokens. overall impact depends on % routed.
Maya (CSM): action items: Samira to deploy canary + eval harness, Devon to create routing policy and cost calc, Ryan to prep renewal note. i'll coordinate a 15m sync tomorrow.
Samira (Infra): starting canary now, will post status updates and the eval output. if we hit any quality regressions i'll flip traffic off instantly. :eyes:
Maya (CSM): thanks team — let's keep comms light in the channel, i'll capture customer feedback and surface any qualitative notes. :thumbsup:
